You yield just enough to feel the force pass you, then guide it somewhere else.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before defending against a visible adjacent physical attacker.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Use Reason for this defense. On a Strong defense, you may pull the attacker 1 square toward your previous position after moving yourself 1 square to a free square without provoking. Both destinations must be legal.
